source_document.document_version: Amended Clinical Trial Protocol 05, Version number: 1

extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single SoA table printed over document pages 18-21 with the header reprinted on each page (de-duplicated). Text-layer PDF; marks verified by pdftotext -bbox column binning; merged spans resolved from raster rule lines (200 dpi) because spans are drawn cell borders. Grey-shaded cells carry no content and are not emitted. Right-hand Notes column converted to annotations. Label columns L=1 (Evaluation); first data column position 2; Notes column (position 12) excluded from the grid. Pages 22-24 (PK/immunogenicity and biomarker flow charts) lie outside the declared SoA range and were not extracted (see review item D1).

table_metadata.table_purpose: Main study schedule: screening, treatment cycles, end of treatment and post-treatment follow-up
table_metadata.notes: Primary anchor grid; one printed table running over four pages under a reprinted header (not continuations). Cross-references PK/ADA and biomarker flow charts on pages 22-24 which are outside the declared SoA range.

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band naming the study phases: Screening (up to 28 days before Day 1), Treatment Phase, End of Treatment (EOT), Post Treatment Follow-up Phase. Major study phases -> epoch. Label column is empty (the 'Evaluation' activity-column header spans all header rows), so the name is synthesised.

Second header band sub-dividing the phases: Cycle 1, Cycle 2 and Beyond (treatment cycles of 21 days per footnote a), Safety follow-up Period, Survival follow-up; empty under Screening and EOT. Mixes treatment cycles with follow-up sub-periods, so classified as period (sub-phases) rather than cycle. Name synthesised (label column empty).

Lowest header band giving the day of each column with its window: D-28 to D-15, D-14 to D-1, D1 (±1), D8 (± 1), D15 (±1), D1 (± 2), and relative follow-up days (30 (±7) days after last IMPs admin, At 60/At 90 (±7) days after last IMPs admin, Every 90 days (±7) after last safety follow-up). Protocol day values -> study_day. Name synthesised (label column empty).

review_items.call_made: Only the Schedule of Activities table on document pages 18-21 (the declared SoA range) was extracted. The 'Pharmacokinetics and Immunogenicity Flow Chart' (pages 22-23) and the 'Exploratory Biomarker Flow Chart' (page 24), which the SoA's PK / ADA / Tumor Biopsy rows point to, were not extracted.
review_items.alternative: Extract the two flow charts as additional tables (Table 02 PK/immunogenicity, Table 03 biomarkers), each typed 'subsidiary' because they give finer timing for the PK, ADA and biomarker activities of Table 01.

review_items.call_made: The merged text 'See Pharmacokinetics and immunogenicity Flow Chart' (PK, ADA rows) and 'See Biomarker Flow Chart' (Tumor Biopsy/Archival Tissue/Biomarker row) is kept as a cell value distributed across every data column 2-11 (source_range 2:11). The printed cell also runs into the Notes column, which is not a data column.
review_items.alternative: Treat each of these as a cross-reference (source_note annotation on the activity) and leave the grid cells of these three rows empty.

review_items.call_made: Header row 2 (Cycle 1 / Cycle 2 and Beyond / Safety follow-up Period / Survival follow-up) is typed 'period' because it mixes treatment cycles with follow-up sub-periods.
review_items.alternative: Type it 'cycle' (the treatment-phase entries are cycles) or 'other'.

review_items.call_made: Blood Typing Interference Test, Serology and Urinalysis (top of page 20) are placed under 'Laboratory Assessments' (indentation 1) across the page break; the bold rows Isatuximab Administration and Atezolizumab Administration and all page-21 rows are top level (indentation 0), not children of 'Disease Assessment'.
review_items.alternative: Treat the page-20 lab rows as top-level, and/or treat the rows after the Disease Assessment block as children of 'Disease Assessment'.

review_items.call_made: Footnote c ('evaluation not applicable for Cohort E') is printed in the Notes cell beside Isatuximab Administration but is bound to every cell carrying a printed superscript c (the D8 and D15 marks of 8 rows, 16 cells), not to the Isatuximab row alone.
review_items.alternative: Also bind footnote c to the Isatuximab Administration row as a whole (because its definition sits in that row's Notes cell), or restrict it to the Isatuximab Administration cells only.

review_items.call_made: Qualified entries in the 'Cycle 2 and Beyond D1' column - 'Cycle 2 Day 1 only' (Blood Typing) and 'X (Weeks 9, 18, 27, and then every 12 weeks)' / 'X (Weeks 6, 12, 18, 24, and then every 9 weeks)' (imaging, tumour markers) - are kept literally in that single column because the qualifiers name timings that are not separate columns of the table.
review_items.alternative: Normalise these to a bare 'X' and move the timing qualifier into a synthesised footnote on the cell.
